message.reasoning:
The user wants to remove the timer.exe that was scheduled earlier using taskkill. They likely want to kill the process and maybe delete the file. We need to use the cmd_controller_execute tool to run a command. The command would be something like `taskkill /IM timer.exe /F` to forcefully terminate it. If they also want to delete the file, we could add `del timer.exe`. But the user said "remove the timer.exe that i have been set earlier using the taskkill command". That implies they want to kill the scheduled task? Actually they used taskkill earlier to schedule? Wait, earlier they used taskkill to kill the process. Now they want to remove the timer.exe that they had set earlier using the taskkill command. So they want to delete the file. So we should run `taskkill /IM timer.exe /F && del timer.exe`. Use unit milliseconds? Not necessary. We'll just call the function.
